Hi,

Thanks for your interest in Canopy. Mutect only outputs somatic point mutations. For allele-specific copy number (ASCN) estimates, we recommend Sequenza. After you call ASCN, you can refer to our GitHub page for how to further generate the major and minor copy numbers.

Best,
Yuchao
